correctness.rationale: Complete group with 336 elements and 413 subgroups via generating-element closure; 22 nonidentity conjugacy representatives. Original ordinary matching faces are disjoint incidence edges, enumerated as 3462 including empty. Each admissible group edge orbit is itself a matching; unions of compatible orbits give precisely the PL geometric fixed simplex model. Inspected verify_fixed.py checks exhaustive orbit-model faces versus independently invariant original faces, records every elementary collapse, verifies the special 21-involution-class remaining eight-triangle suspension of C4 (S2) with an extra path attached between sphere points (adds S1), and in the known 28-polarity case reduces a 23-generator pi1 presentation using 23 triangle-relator single-letter eliminations before using free H2 rank four. Independently generated all 413 subgroups and F2 fixed-space homology ranks for all 22 representatives, reproducing counts: empty46, zero105, H0:140+30 distinction by component counts, H1^2:42, H2^4:28, H1+H2:21. Finite exact exhaustive group enumeration plus explicit topological reductions prove the finite theorem; F2 alone is not the integral proof.
